researchPlan.objective: Identify active software engineering job openings for React developers at Indian tech startups with direct application links.
researchPlan.title: Indian Tech Startup React Developer Jobs

outputFields.name: job_title
outputFields.description: Official title of the job posting
outputFields.validationHint: Must contain keywords like React, Frontend, Full Stack, or Software Engineer
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for H1 or prominent titles on job listing pages

outputFields.name: company_name
outputFields.description: Name of the Indian startup hiring
outputFields.validationHint: Must be a valid company name, not a recruiter agency name
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for company branding, employer header, or 'about company' section

outputFields.name: location
outputFields.description: Job location or remote status in India
outputFields.validationHint: Must specify India, Remote (India), or major Indian tech hub (e.g., Bengaluru, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Hyderabad)
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for location badge near job title or workplace type

outputFields.name: job_url
outputFields.description: Direct application link or ATS job posting URL
outputFields.validationHint: Must be a live URL starting with http/https pointing to direct application page
outputFields.extractionHint: Capture the canonical URL or application button target link

outputFields.name: tech_stack_requirements
outputFields.description: Key technologies required along with React
outputFields.validationHint: Should mention React and associated frontend or fullstack tech
outputFields.extractionHint: Extract from requirements, qualifications, or tech stack section

outputFields.name: posted_date
outputFields.description: Date or relative timeframe when the job was posted
outputFields.extractionHint: Look for posting timestamp or metadata tags

searchQueries: site:lever.co OR site:greenhouse.io OR site:ashbyhq.com "React" developer startup India
"React Developer" OR "Frontend Engineer" startup hiring Bengaluru OR Gurgaon OR Remote India jobs
"Software Engineer" "React" hiring startup India careers apply
researchPlan.sourceStrategy: Prioritize direct Applicant Tracking Systems (Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby) and startup-focused platforms (Wellfound, Cutshort) to ensure listings are active and direct.

validationRules.rule: Must be a valid, direct listing URL and not a generic job board search result page
Must be an active tech startup operating in or headquartered in India
Must explicitly require React.js experience in description or title

stoppingConditions: Minimum 5 fully validated React developer job listings from unique Indian startups collected
researchPlan.complianceNotes: Only aggregate publicly available career listings directly from company sites or public job portals.
